context:
Goal: a shipping label screen you are happy to use every day.
Problem (goal): the label screen build starts only once you approve how it looks.
Based on (read): branch design/tcgt-labels at df8bae374 holds the Shipping mockup in 12 states and the Orders mockup in 9, each at 1440 and 820 in both themes. Asked in chat at 13:40 CST, with no answer yet.
The five pictures above are the new parts of Shipping at 1440, light. Use Prev and Next to page through them, or Open full size to enlarge. The first four show the Make Labels panel, and the fifth shows the new no-file note.
The no-file note reads: "Banchi keeps each envelope order's address, so it can make the label. The file is forgotten after 30 minutes. No buyer info shows here."
Your notes so far:
2026-11-02 20:38 CST, "I don't see anything in the photo": the pictures were cut off. They were replaced with links.
2026-11-03 14:43 CST, "bring those links into this question": the pictures are now on this card.
2026-11-03 14:48 CST, "none of these": you want the cards in each order shown, on hover or some other way, and the screen does not look good enough yet. That asks for changes. banchi-coordinator sends it to the designer for another round, and this item is rewritten with the new mockups.
All 21 states, if you want them: https://github.com/shivinate7/banchi/tree/design/tcgt-labels/docs/design
